description: This is a Python source file defining functions for profiling RNN models, including setup, execution, and system profiling via nvprof. It contains functions for running RNNs with specific parameters, system command execution, and filename generation for profiling outputs. It also includes a command-line interface for scripting profiling runs.

methods.name: run_rnn( name, rnn_creator, nloops=5, seqLength=100, numLayers=1, inputSize=512, hiddenSize=512, miniBatch=64, device="cuda", seed=None, )
methods.description: Runs an RNN model with specified parameters, executing multiple iterations, including forward, backward, and parameter update steps.

methods.name: profile( rnns, sleep_between_seconds=1, nloops=5, internal_run=True, seqLength=100, numLayers=1, inputSize=512, hiddenSize=512, miniBatch=64, device="cuda", seed=None, )
methods.description: Profiles multiple RNNs by executing each with given configuration parameters, optionally sleeping between runs.

methods.name: system(command)
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its return code, stdout, and stderr.

methods.name: describe_sizes(**sizes)
methods.description: Generates a string description of RNN size parameters for labeling profiling outputs.

methods.name: nvprof_output_filename(rnns, **params)
methods.description: Generates a filename for nvprof profiling output based on RNN types, size parameters, and timestamp.

methods.name: nvprof(cmd, outpath)
methods.description: Runs nvprof profiling on a command, saving output to specified file.

methods.name: full_profile(rnns, **args)
methods.description: Constructs profiling commands for all specified RNNs and runs nvprof with the generated parameters.
